examwork-2: Stock market news and price observer
examworkdescription: A brief description of the project
examworkdescription1: In addition to completing the exam, I had to submit an exam project. My project was a conceptual webshop design, which primarily focused on the visual presentation and dynamically generated content from JavaScript.
examworkdescription1-2: This modern, responsive stock market portal utilizes live data connections to provide a comprehensive overview of the current market status of leading technology companies. Powered by the Finnhub API, the platform displays global financial news, alongside real-time stock prices, company descriptions, and founder details for selected assets. The user experience is enhanced by an interactive Chart.js analysis diagram that visualizes market recommendations in a structured and easy-to-read format. The clean design, featuring a modern glassmorphism control panel, subtle hover effects, and dynamic scroll animations, all contribute to a highly professional and premium aesthetic.
solvedtask1: Responsive Design: Mobile-first approach, optimization for all screen sizes
solvedtask3: JavaScript-based dynamic elements and event handling
solvedtask4: Successful integration of the Finnhub REST API. Utilizing JavaScript's fetch and async/await, the application communicates with the server asynchronously in the background, allowing stock prices and news to update seamlessly without reloading the webpage.
solvedtask5: Creation of a responsive stacked bar chart using the Chart.js library. I performed data manipulation on the raw API payload using JavaScript (.slice() and .reverse()) to ensure the chart renders chronologically from left to right (moving from the past toward the present).
solvedtask6: Designing and managing a custom, structured local JSON database (companies.json). Upon changing the dropdown menu selection, the JavaScript logic simultaneously fetches data from the external API and reads the local JSON file, merging them into a single, unified user interface.
solvedtask7: Combining the Bootstrap 5 grid system, Flexbox layouts, and modern SASS/SCSS techniques. I successfully implemented equal-height news cards (utilizing object-fit: cover for image cropping), a modern glassmorphic dashboard panel, and scroll-triggered animations using the IntersectionObserver API, which minimizes initial page load and enhances the overall user experience (UX).
